exposure: continuous group care with online and offline service
Continuous group care with online and offline service
outcome: Rate of excessive prenatal weight gain
cohort: 144 pregnant women in a first-class tertiary general hospital in Hainan Province, China
finding: The continuous group care model effectively controlled gestational weight gain, reduced the rates of cesarean section, macrosomia, and postpartum depression, and improved self-efficacy and exclusive breastfeeding rates.
mod_finding: The rate of cesarean section was significantly lower in the intervention group receiving continuous group care.
